art_direction: 26岁原创女主穿松石色外套，提着相机在清晨街角回望。
composition_variation: Render an original 26-year-old anime woman with long ink-black hair and amber eyes, turning naturally during a morning photo walk. She wears an opaque turquoise long jacket over a striped high-neck top and full-length black trousers. A small unbranded camera hangs securely from her wrist at waist level. Use luminous cel shading, peach facades, teal shadows, and a playful confident glance over one shoulder without suggestive posing. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
